Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless repeating top-down floor texture for LAST EMBER, a neon arcade survival game. A square texture made of nearly black deep-navy matte stone or alloy with extremely subtle broad polygonal wear and a few very faint blue cracks. Flat orthographic directly overhead, perfectly uniform illumination, no gradients, no vignette, no center motif, no directional lighting. Low contrast, dark values approximately #080b13 through #101827. Seamless/tileable on all four edges with matching edges. Mostly broad quiet flat areas, sparing surface variation that stays unobtrusive at 512px tile size. Intended beneath many tiny glowing orange, magenta and turquoise gameplay objects. No grid lines, symbols, writing, floor props, walls, bright highlights, particles, holes, raised objects, borders or watermark. Fill the complete opaque square.
